# Outlier Weekly

Outlier Weekly is Cemini23's weekly letter on mispriced rare-event markets on
Polymarket and Kalshi, plus operator notes on Atto paperwork, GuruWatcher
alerts, and the Cursor/DeepSeek/Grok agent harness. This domain hosts the
owned hub pages; the letters themselves live on Substack.

- https://outlierweekly.com/cxw-geo/
- https://outlierweekly.com/agent-harness/
